subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should OpenClaw expose `agents.list[].description` through `agents_list` as a stable agent-discovery field for orchestrators?
rationale: Current main already accepts the config metadata, but returning it to agents is a user-facing tool/API and prompt-surface choice that requires maintainer product direction.

options.title: Expose descriptions in agents_list
options.body: Merge or repair the linked PR so nonblank configured descriptions are returned with focused tests and docs.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Preserve the config field but reject exposing it through `agents_list`, then close the linked PR and this issue with that boundary.

options.title: Fold into broader discovery
options.body: Track the need under a larger sibling-agent discovery design instead of adding a narrow field now.

recommendation.title: Expose descriptions in agents_list
recommendation.body: Merge or repair the linked PR so nonblank configured descriptions are returned with focused tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history across `agents_list` and the multi-agent config/routing paths involved in the product decision.
